Marcus / team,

Quick update from our side — finance is asking if we can firm up licensing and timeline by the 20th of April. Theres a cross-functional review next week and they want a one-page mutual action plan and cost summary to justify shifting budget into Q2 instead of Q3.

High level: BlueOrbit still plans to move forward, but procurement needs clearer stage evidence (POC sign-off date, decision committee, and final contract owner). Can you share a concise breakdown of remaining milestones and a draft MAP by EOD Monday so we can present to Finance?

Dana — thanks for the heads up. Well own the MAP and the financial breakdown. High-level status from our side and asks below: 

Current pipe-to-quota snapshot (mid-market):
- Weighted pipeline: $1.2M
- Q2 target: $1.8M
- Coverage: ~67% (gap: $600k)
- BlueOrbit opportunity (BO-1147) current ARR: $320k weighted at 60% -> $192k toward coverage

Gaps and asks (what I need from BlueOrbit to close the loop):
1) Confirm POC sign-off date (you mentioned internal trial completes 4/16)
2) Confirm final decision committee date and attendees (Finance + IT required)
3) Procurement timeline for contract signature (target close date)

Internal asks (owners below please confirm by EOD Monday 4/15):
- Marissa: update HubSpot stages for BO-1147 with POC evidence and attach the POC summary (file: BO-POC-summary.pdf).
- Karthik: prepare a 1-slide cost delta that shows how moving to Q2 affects FY29 revenue recognition. Use the attached License-Checklist.pdf as reference.
- Laura: align CS on go/no-go criteria and confirm post-sale onboarding SLA (we need this for Finance brief).

Im attaching a draft MAP (BO-MAP-v2.xlsx) and a one-page cost summary. Dana — if you can confirm dates requested above, Ill finalize the MAP and share a clean PDF for your Finance meeting.
